data.name: Transfers.HowItWorks
data.value: Import location history from Google Timeline (Google Takeout) or a supported Wayfarer export. Large files are processed in the background. You can leave this page and check back later.

data.name: Transfers.StatusHelp
data.value: In progress: processing the file. Completed: check the deleted-record and Activity counts. Stopped: paused by the user. Failed: check the error details.

data.name: Transfers.InvalidActivity.one
data.value: Invalid Activity in {0} Location. Correct it by editing the Location.

data.name: Transfers.InvalidActivity.other
data.value: Invalid Activity in {0} Locations. Correct them by editing the Locations.

data.name: Transfers.Confirm.Resume
data.value: Resume this import from its saved progress?

data.name: Transfers.Confirm.Remove
data.value: Remove this import record? This cannot be undone.

data.name: Transfers.StagedUnavailable
data.value: The staged import file is unavailable. Upload the file again to continue.

data.name: Transfers.RecoveryHeld
data.value: Native recovery content is incomplete or unsupported. Correct the file before importing.

data.name: Transfers.InvalidKey
data.value: An IdempotencyKey is invalid. Correct the UUID values and upload the corrected file as a new import.

data.name: Transfers.MultipleZeroKeys
data.value: Multiple IdempotencyKey values are zero. Give distinct captures unique nonzero UUIDs and upload the corrected file as a new import.

data.name: Transfers.InvalidCheckpoint
data.value: Saved import progress no longer matches the file. Upload the file as a new import to continue.

data.name: Transfers.ImportProcessingFailed
data.value: The file could not be processed. Check the file and try again.

data.name: Transfers.StartPending
data.value: Import accepted and awaiting scheduler recovery.

data.name: Transfers.StartInvalidState
data.value: Import cannot be started in its current state.

data.name: Transfers.DeletePending
data.value: Deletion requested. Upload cleanup is pending reconciliation.

data.name: Transfers.DeleteActive
data.value: Upload is active or stopping and cannot be removed yet.

data.name: Transfers.DeleteFailed
data.value: Upload record could not be removed.

data.name: Transfers.UploadsDisabled
data.value: File uploads are disabled by the administrator.

data.name: Transfers.UploadTooLarge
data.value: The upload request exceeds the allowed size. Choose a smaller file and try again.

data.name: Transfers.UploadUnavailable
data.value: The upload cannot be accepted right now. Try again later.

data.name: Transfers.UploadLimit
data.value: Upload a supported location-history file. The complete request, including form fields and multipart overhead, must fit within {0} MiB.

data.name: Transfers.ActivityHelp
data.value: Valid Activity names reuse or create entries in the shared catalog, visible to all authenticated users. Activity names are optional. Invalid values leave Locations without an Activity and appear as a warning count in import history.

data.name: Transfers.ContinueEnrichment
data.value: Continue filling missing addresses after the import completes

data.name: Transfers.ContinueHelp
data.value: The import can finish independently. If selected, Wayfarer fills missing addresses in scheduled batches. Provider availability may pause this work without removing imported data.

data.name: Transfers.InvalidFile
data.value: Please select a valid, nonempty file.

data.name: Transfers.InvalidFormat
data.value: Please select a valid file type.

data.name: Transfers.UnsupportedGeoJson
data.value: Generic GeoJSON is not a supported location-history format. Select Wayfarer GeoJSON for Wayfarer exports.

data.name: Transfers.InvalidExtension
data.value: The file extension “{0}” is invalid. Allowed extensions: {1}.

data.name: Transfers.SignInRequired
data.value: Sign in to upload location history.

data.name: Transfers.Uploaded
data.value: File uploaded successfully and is pending import.

data.name: Transfers.UploadFailed
data.value: The file could not be saved for import. Try uploading it again later.

data.name: Transfers.EnrichmentHelp
data.value: Importing may finish before enrichment. Imported Locations remain safe if enrichment is paused, cancelled, or fails, and large histories may take days. Cancelling enrichment does not cancel or delete imports.

data.name: Transfers.GeoapifyWindow
data.value: Wayfarer uses a rolling 24-hour window shared by geocoding and routing.

data.name: Transfers.MapboxWindow
data.value: Wayfarer meters Permanent Geocoding by calendar month in UTC.

data.name: Transfers.ProviderUsageHelp
data.value: Geoapify geocoding and routing share Wayfarer's rolling pool. Usage elsewhere in your provider account is not visible here. Mapbox Permanent requires separate consent and uses Wayfarer's independent monthly meter. Deleting import history does not delete Locations or enrichment.

data.name: Transfers.IncompleteHelp
data.value: Incomplete addresses describe stored fields, not additional scheduled requests. Initiate Repair to prepare them. Temporary repair failures appear under Retryable later. Next attempt is shown while the workflow is enabled. You can also edit an address manually.

data.name: Transfers.RepairsWithoutLocality.one
data.value: For {0} attempted repair, the provider supplied no city, place or usable result. The address remains incomplete and will not be retried automatically. You can run Repair again while enrichment is stopped or edit the address manually.

data.name: Transfers.RepairsWithoutLocality.other
data.value: For {0} attempted repairs, the provider supplied no city, place or usable result. Those addresses remain incomplete and will not be retried automatically. You can run Repair again while enrichment is stopped or edit the addresses manually.

data.name: Transfers.StoppedRetryHelp
data.value: Saved retry times do not restart enrichment automatically while it is stopped.
